question: In which Indian city was the inaugural Pro Wrestling League season's final match contested?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **inaugural season** of the **Pro Wrestling League (PWL)** was held in **2015-16**. This event marked the beginning of a professional wrestling league in India, which features top-level international and Indian wrestlers.
 
• The final match of the **first season of PWL** was contested in the city of **New Delhi**, which is also the capital city of India.
 
• The venue for the final was the iconic **Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium**, one of the largest indoor sports arenas in the country, known for hosting various significant national and international sporting events.
 
• The Pro Wrestling League is organized by **ProSportify** in association with the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI). It aims to promote wrestling as a sport in India and provide a platform for Indian wrestlers to showcase their talents globally.
 
• The league follows a franchise-based format, and top wrestlers, including Olympic and World Championship medalists, participate in the event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pro Wrestling League:**

 
 
• The Pro Wrestling League was launched in India in **2015** to popularize wrestling and attract global attention to Indian wrestlers.
 
• The league features teams representing different regions of India, with each team comprising both Indian and international wrestlers.
 
• The matches follow the **freestyle wrestling format**, and the league is conducted under the rules of the **United World Wrestling (UWW)**.
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium:**
 
 
• Located in **New Delhi**, the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium is one of Asia's largest indoor sports venues.
 
• It has hosted several prestigious events, including the **Asian Games**, **Commonwealth Games**, and other international sports tournaments.
 
 
 
• **Wrestling Federation of India (WFI):**
 
 
• The WFI is the governing body for wrestling in India, responsible for promoting and developing the sport across the nation.
 
• It organizes national championships and collaborates with international bodies like UWW to ensure global representation for Indian wrestlers.
 
 
 
• **Notable Wrestlers in PWL:**
 
 
• The league has witnessed participation from renowned Indian wrestlers like **Sushil Kumar**, **Bajrang Punia**, and **Vinesh Phogat**.
 
• International stars such as **Yogeshwar Dutt** and Olympic medalists have also been part of the league.
 
 
 
• **Impact of PWL:**
 
 
• PWL has played a crucial role in increasing the popularity of wrestling in India, inspiring young athletes to take up the sport.
 
• The league has also provided Indian wrestlers with opportunities to compete against world-class opponents, enhancing their skills and performance.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Wrestling in India:** Wrestling, also known as **Kushti**, has deep cultural and historical roots in India. It is one of the traditional sports practiced in rural regions through **akhadas** (wrestling arenas).
 
• **Global Wrestling Events:** India has performed exceptionally well in global wrestling events, winning several medals in the **Olympics**, **Commonwealth Games**, and **Asian Games**.
 
• **Government Support:** The Indian government and sports authorities have been actively promoting wrestling through various schemes and initiatives, such as the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)**.
